channel_definition.replaced: hotspot_cumsum_4w / hotspot_cumsum_12w (which accumulate ALL HotSpot >= 0) are REPLACED by the C_W channels (HotSpot >= 1 degC only, CRW DHW convention); d_hotspot_dt retained
channel_definition.partial_window_note: For the first W-1 dates of each domain record (t < W-1), C_W is a partial sum over the available history only. This affects at most the first ~12 weeks of 2003 (SCS train period); val/test and GBR zero-shot start years later. Training (run_step7) and evaluation (compute_step7) both use this same construction, so semantics are consistent with the saved checkpoints.

note: cumulative HotSpot channels are physically meaningful historical thermal-stress variables (NOAA CRW DHW = 12-week accumulation of HotSpot >= 1 degC); this is a temporal-scale decomposition, NOT a leakage/shortcut claim
